message: You know those times when you think, "If only I was ready for this!"? I've had my fair share of those moments, especially when it comes to car emergencies. That’s why I found this resource from Ready.gov super useful—it's all about how to prepare yourself and your car for unexpected situations. I like to think of it as my little "I told you so" guide for when life throws a curveball. What’s your go-to tip for being ready on the road? 🚗
